level.title: A2 Elementary Telugu
goals: Use Telugu script with romanisation and accurate English meaning.
Adapt language to age, relationship, context, and register.

lessons.title: Health and Wellbeing — A2
lessons.learn: Handle routine situations with polite requests, time reference, linked actions, and practical questions. This lesson applies that progression to health & doctor.

grammar.title: Health and Wellbeing structures
grammar.explain: Handle routine situations with polite requests, time reference, linked actions, and practical questions. Telugu keeps the finite verb near the end; case, tense, respect, and clause links are commonly carried by suffixes.
grammar.pattern: context + case-marked participants + object/complement + finite verb
mistakes: Do not copy English word order or remove Telugu suffixes; keep the complete model and choose a respectful form for elders and formal settings.

practice.q: Translate in context: పిల్లల డాక్టర్ (pillala ḍākṭar)
Write in Telugu: ambulance
Produce the complete Telugu expression: I am not feeling well
Choose the Telugu expression for “emergency ward”.
Say naturally in Telugu: My head aches

quiz.q: What does పిల్లల డాక్టర్ (pillala ḍākṭar) mean here?
quiz.why: In this context పిల్లల డాక్టర్ (pillala ḍākṭar) means “children's doctor.”

quiz.q: What does అత్యవసర విభాగం (atyavasara vibhāgaṁ) mean here?
quiz.why: In this context అత్యవసర విభాగం (atyavasara vibhāgaṁ) means “emergency ward.”

tasks.instruction: Match Telugu expressions to their English meanings.
Translate while preserving meaning and register.
